footer.aboutText: This quiz is for entertainment and self-reflection only. It does not prove a real soulmate, twin flame, karmic bond, destiny, or relationship outcome. Results are playful spiritual-style profiles based only on your quiz choices.

landing.quickStartText: Answer quick questions about the pull, the lessons, and the timing. Your bond profile appears at the end.

profiles.title: Your bond profile is a Karmic Lesson.
profiles.copy: This connection energy feels intense, memorable, and packed with lessons. It may highlight patterns, choices, and parts of yourself that are ready to be understood more clearly.

profiles.title: Your bond profile is a Soulmate Bond.
profiles.copy: This connection energy feels warm, steady, and emotionally familiar. It points toward comfort, trust, and the kind of closeness that feels easy to return to.

profiles.title: Your bond profile is a Twin Flame Mirror.
profiles.copy: This connection energy feels magnetic, intense, and hard to ignore. It may reflect your strongest feelings back to you in a way that feels both exciting and revealing.

profiles.title: Your bond profile is a Past-Life Tie.
profiles.copy: This connection energy feels strangely familiar, as if the emotional rhythm arrived before the explanation. It points toward recognition, mystery, and deep emotional echoes.

profiles.title: Your bond profile is a Healing Connection.
profiles.copy: This connection energy feels gentle, honest, and restorative. It points toward emotional repair, softer communication, and a bond that helps you feel more like yourself.

profiles.title: Your bond profile is Fated Partner energy.
profiles.copy: This connection energy feels timely, meaningful, and bigger than coincidence. It points toward shared direction, strong timing, and the feeling that something important is unfolding.

profiles.title: Your bond profile is a Shadow Mirror.
profiles.copy: This connection energy feels revealing, challenging, and emotionally sharp. It may bring hidden feelings to the surface so they can be seen with more honesty.

profiles.title: Your bond profile is a Sacred Companion.
profiles.copy: This connection energy feels calm, loyal, and quietly powerful. It points toward presence, devotion, and the kind of bond that grows through consistency.

stageGroups.title: The First Pull
stageGroups.encouragement: The first pull says more than people think. The next round looks at the lessons and mirrors inside the bond.

questions.prompt: What did the connection feel like at first?
choices: Calm, familiar, and easy to trust
Electric, intense, and impossible to ignore
Complicated, but strangely important

questions.prompt: What makes this person stay on your mind?
choices: The feeling that you already know them
The way they bring hidden feelings up
The timing feels oddly meaningful

questions.prompt: Which moment would feel most meaningful?
choices: A quiet conversation that makes you feel safe
A moment where you both grow softer
A promise shown through steady actions

questions.prompt: How does the chemistry usually feel?
choices: Peaceful, warm, and emotionally steady
Powerful, magnetic, and a little overwhelming
Unpredictable, but full of lessons

questions.prompt: What is the strongest sign this bond matters?
choices: It helps you heal old feelings
It feels like it arrived at the exact right time
It reveals things you usually avoid

questions.prompt: Pick the phrase that fits the connection best.
choices: We feel familiar for no clear reason
We keep teaching each other something
We bring out a deeper version of each other

questions.prompt: What would make you trust the bond more?
choices: Consistency over time
Gentle honesty after hard moments
A shared sense of direction

questions.prompt: What kind of message would affect you most?
choices: I feel at home with you
You make me face myself
I think we met for a reason

questions.prompt: When the connection feels intense, what do you notice?
choices: It pulls me forward
It tests old patterns
It asks for patience and devotion

questions.prompt: What would you secretly hope this bond becomes?
choices: A peaceful love that lasts
A turning point that changes everything
A safe place to become softer

stageGroups.title: Lessons And Mirrors
stageGroups.encouragement: The bond is getting clearer. The final round reveals which connection energy is strongest.

questions.prompt: What does this connection seem to teach you?
choices: How to stop repeating a pattern
How to let safe love in
How to be honest with your deeper feelings

questions.prompt: When emotions rise, what matters most?
choices: Taking space without losing the bond
Repairing the moment with care
Letting the truth come out

questions.prompt: Which pattern feels most familiar?
choices: The connection returns when you least expect it
The connection feels calm even after distance
The connection seems linked to timing

questions.prompt: What kind of growth does the bond create?
choices: Learning what not to carry anymore
Learning how to be seen clearly
Learning how to choose steady devotion

questions.prompt: When you do not hear from them, what happens inside you?
choices: You feel the intensity spike, then try to ground yourself
You notice the worry and want a softer check-in
You trust the timing, even if the silence feels strange

questions.prompt: What makes the bond hard to explain to someone else?
choices: The familiar feeling showed up too quickly
They seem to notice parts of you that you hide
The same lesson keeps appearing around them

questions.prompt: After a disagreement, what usually stays with you?
choices: The intensity of what was said
The relief when the bond still feels safe
The chance to repair something gently

questions.prompt: Which kind of bond feels most real to you?
choices: One that chooses you again and again
One that arrives with strange timing
One that feels familiar from the start

questions.prompt: What would be hardest to ignore?
choices: The unfinished feeling between you
The emotional safety you feel
The way they reveal your blind spots

questions.prompt: What would make you walk away from the connection?
choices: If there was no space for kindness or repair
If the truth kept being avoided
If the timing kept pulling you away from yourself

questions.prompt: When you imagine the bond ending, what feels unfinished?
choices: The sense that the timing still means something
The quiet comfort you would miss
The lesson you still have not fully understood

questions.prompt: What do they seem to awaken in you?
choices: A softer part that wants to heal
A raw part that wants to be seen
A familiar part you cannot explain

questions.prompt: Which feeling would you trust most?
choices: This bond asks for loyalty
This bond asks for truth
This bond asks for emotional courage

questions.prompt: If a friend asked why this person matters, what would you say?
choices: They showed me a pattern I needed to see
They make love feel steady instead of confusing
They arrived at a moment that felt impossible to ignore

questions.prompt: What kind of closeness feels strongest?
choices: Gentle closeness that feels safe
Mysterious closeness that feels familiar
Patient closeness that keeps showing up

questions.prompt: Which emotional clue feels most accurate?
choices: They bring up unfinished feelings
They make you feel seen in a raw way
They make the future feel possible

questions.prompt: What does the connection do at its best?
choices: It makes love feel calm and real
It makes old pain feel less heavy
It makes life feel more alive

questions.prompt: Which phrase feels closest to your bond?
choices: We are here to choose each other gently
We are here to remember something deep
We are here to face the truth

questions.prompt: What question do you keep replaying?
choices: What was I meant to learn from this?
Can this become gentler and healthier?
Was the timing trying to point me somewhere?

questions.prompt: Choose the final bond energy.
choices: Safe, familiar, and steady
Intense, revealing, and magnetic
Mystical, devoted, and meaningful
